view: Frontal chest radiograph, AP projection (paediatric; mandible/teeth and both shoulders included, arms slightly abducted), erect or semi-erect; L marker at image right confirms conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate but not ideal: mild rotation to the patient's left (asymmetric medial clavicular ends relative to the spinous processes), adequate inspiration (about 6-7 anterior ribs), reasonable penetration (thoracic spine visible through the heart). Both scapulae project over the lateral upper lung fields and the chin/mandible overlaps the upper neck/thoracic inlet. Costophrenic angles and both lung apices included. AP projection and rotation may exaggerate the cardiac silhouette.

devices.location: Right ear lobe, projected at the upper edge of the film lateral to the right mandible
Left ear lobe, projected at the upper edge of the film lateral to the left mandible

devices.type: Round radiopaque disc (external positioning/side marker or coin-like object), adjacent to the L/DG lead marker
devices.location: Outside the patient, upper left field of view (image upper right), above the left shoulder

devices.type: Small round radiopaque object with central lucency (clothing snap or ECG electrode)
devices.location: Projected over the left shoulder / lateral left clavicle-acromion region

abnormalities.finding: Cardiomegaly: globular enlargement of the cardiac silhouette, cardiothoracic ratio approximately 0.55 (transverse cardiac diameter about 350 of 645 px inner thoracic width), above the expected upper limit for a 7-year-old; predominantly left-sided (apex) prominence, no widening of the superior mediastinum. Caveat: AP projection and mild leftward rotation magnify the heart
abnormalities.laterality: midline/central, projects into both hemithoraces, predominantly left

abnormalities.finding: Mild prominence of perihilar bronchovascular markings (right slightly more than left) without Kerley lines, interstitial edema, or alveolar opacity - equivocal, could be within normal paediatric range

description_zh: 前後位(AP)胸部X光，病人輕度向左旋轉，吸氣深度尚可，雙側肩胛骨及下頜部分重疊於胸腔上方。心影呈球狀擴大，心胸比約0.55，超過此年齡層之正常上限，顯示心臟擴大（惟AP投影及旋轉會使心影放大，需結合臨床判讀）；上縱隔未見增寬，氣管居中。雙肺野大致清晰，肺門血管紋理略顯，未見實質浸潤、肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利，橫膈輪廓完整。骨骼結構無明顯異常；體外異物包括雙耳耳環、左上視野外側之圓形金屬標記物及左肩區小圓形體外物，未見胸管、引流管或其他治療性裝置。
